title: AI Actor Generator for Realistic UGC Video Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Make realistic UGC video ads with AI actors. Write a line, pick a presenter, and get a 9:16 ad in minutes, no casting, studio or creator contract.
h1: Create More Ad Versions Faster with AI Actors
lead: Give your script to a realistic on-screen presenter and test more hooks, actors and offers every week, without casting calls, studios or creator contracts.

m2.h2: Create an AI Actor Video in Three Steps
m2.lead: One product photo, one line, and a presenter who speaks it on camera.

steps.sourceHint: One clear product photo is enough to start
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. In a bright bathroom, the selected actor holds the sky-blue moisturizer jar toward the camera, then touches one cheek. Natural creator delivery says: "This is the moisturizer step I keep beside the sink." Sound: her voice and quiet bathroom room tone.

items.d: One clear photo becomes a 9:16 ad you can check against the real item before anyone sees it.

items.t: Write a Line and Pick a Presenter
items.d: Share your video idea in one sentence, then choose a presenter who speaks the words with matching lip movement.
Get a 10-second vertical clip ready for paid social and short-form feeds, and make a fresh version whenever the offer changes.

more_sections.h2: Different Use-Cases for AI Actor Videos
more_sections.lead: The same presenters fit the places sellers actually need a talking video.

items.d: Test presenters, hooks and offers against different audiences without paying creators, sets or crews for every new angle.
Let a presenter walk visitors through a key feature and answer a common question, so shoppers see the item in use before they buy.
Keep a steady flow of fresh vertical clips for short-form feeds without running out of content between launches.
Turn setup steps and usage instructions into a short presenter-led video that shoppers can watch instead of reading a long manual.

faq.a: An AI actor is a realistic generated presenter built for video. You choose the person, give them your line and get a video of them speaking it on camera.

faq.q: How do AI actors turn a script into a video?
faq.a: You write or paste a short line, choose a presenter, and the video is generated with their voice and lip movement matched to your words.

faq.q: Where can I use videos made with AI actors?
faq.a: Sellers run them as paid social ads, on product pages, in organic social posts and in short product guides and explainers.

faq.q: How do I make a product ad with an AI actor?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, write a short line, pick a presenter and generate the clip, then download it and add captions or your offer in your own editor.

faq.q: What sizes and lengths are available?
faq.a: Actor videos come in a vertical 9:16 format at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The directory starts you with a 10-second draft for a first review.

faq.q: Can I choose how the presenter looks?
faq.a: Yes. The directory has 36 presenters across different ages, styles and settings, and each card links to the same spokesperson workspace with that person selected.

faq.q: How much does an actor video cost?
faq.a: Videos are paid with credits. A 10-second actor video costs 40 credits, and plans start with 200 credits; unused credits do not roll over.

faq.q: Do I need to say the presenter is AI-generated?
faq.a: Follow the disclosure rules of the platform where you run the ad, and never present an AI actor as a real customer or reviewer.
